description: Production-oriented Weaviate database dashboard for KubeDB managed clusters.

targets.expr: sum by (route, status_code) (rate(weaviate_http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m])) or sum by (route, status_code) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(weaviate_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m])))

sum by (grpc_service, method, status) (rate(weaviate_grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m])) or sum by (grpc_service, method, status) (rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, grpc_service, method) (rate(weaviate_grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, grpc_service, method) (rate(grpc_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}[5m])))

sum by (grpc_service, method) (weaviate_grpc_server_requests_inflight{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"}) or sum by (grpc_service, method) (grpc_server_requests_inflight{namespace="$namespace",service=~"$app-stats"})

100 * sum by (pod) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace="$namespace"} * on (persistentvolumeclaim, namespace) group_left (pod) kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"$app-\\d+$"}) / sum by (pod) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace="$namespace"} * on (persistentvolumeclaim, namespace) group_left (pod) kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"$app-\\d+$"})
